patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Salesforce documents a broader use-case set; Adobe Marketo Engage is narrower/specialist.

Comparison thesis: General-purpose vs specialist. Choose Adobe Marketo Engage only if your buying job matches “Enterprise B2B marketing automation platform (Adobe Marketo Engage) — custom quote; CRM se” rather than Salesforce's shape. Choose Salesforce only if your buying job matches “Enterprise CRM platform for sales, service, marketing, and customer data across large and ” rather than Adobe Marketo Engage's shape. Workflow advantage: Adobe Marketo Engage leans marketing-automation, lead-generation; Salesforce leans pipeline-management, lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Salesforce documents a broader use-case set; Adobe Marketo Engage is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: Adobe Marketo Engage is Enterprise B2B marketing automation platform (Adobe Marketo Engage) — custom quote; CRM secondary.; Salesforce is Enterprise CRM platform for sales, service, marketing, and customer data across large and mid-market teams..
- Workflow coverage skew: Adobe Marketo Engage-leaning marketing-automation, lead-generation, lead-nurturing vs Salesforce-leaning pipeline-management, lead-management, sales-automation.
- Researched limits: Adobe Marketo Engage — Custom quote only — no public list-price transparency; Salesforce — USD list pricing rises quickly: Pro Suite $100, Enterprise $175, Unlimited $350 per user/month (annual). Add-ons (Agentforce for Sales from $125 Contact us, Revenue Intelligence, Success Plans) increase TCO..

Limitations — Adobe Marketo Engage: Custom quote only — no public list-price transparency; Implementation/ops overhead is enterprise-grade; Salesforce: USD list pricing rises quickly: Pro Suite $100, Enterprise $175, Unlimited $350 per user/month (annual). Add-ons (Agentforce for Sales from $125 Contact us, Revenue Intelligence, Success Plans) increase TCO.; Premier Support is an add-on on Pro Suite. Agentforce for Sales, Sales Programs, Revenue Intelligence, and Revenue Cloud are separate paid add-ons; some require Contact us..

Poor-fit cases: Adobe Marketo Engage is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Custom quote only — no public list-price transparency · Salesforce is a poor fit when that limitation bites: USD list pricing rises quickly: Pro Suite $100, Enterprise $175, Unlimited $350 per user/month (annual). Add-ons (Agentforce for Sales from $125 Contact us, Revenue Intelligence, Success Plans) increase TCO. · Avoid Adobe Marketo Engage if you actually need Salesforce's motion (Enterprise CRM platform for sales, service, marketing, and customer data across )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
